title: Quantity
description: A measured or modelled value. Exactly one of value, age or derived supplies it. Units are mandatory for physical values; ranges let the validator flag abnormal or impossible eyes.

value.description: Scalar, or an RGB triple for per-colour optical properties.

age.description: Piecewise-linear function of the subject's age in years: [[age, value], ...], ascending by age.

derived.description: Expression computed from other quantities. Reference values as {component.id:facet.property}; supports + - * / ( ) and min, max, sum.

unit.description: SI-style unit, e.g. mm, 1/mm, deg, cells/mm2, grade, ratio, rgb.

normal.description: Healthy adult range [min, max]. Outside it the eye is abnormal but possible.

hard.description: Physically possible range [min, max]. Outside it the eye is invalid.
